title: Self-Injury Trauma Scale and Injury Monitoring
sub: The physical consequences of self-injury over the course of a case: the Self-Injury Trauma (SIT) Scale of Iwata, Pace, Kissel, Nau and Farber (1990) administered at intake and at intervals on a body map, scored as published (Number Index, Severity Index, Estimate of Current Risk), every administration kept with its map, the indices graphed over time, and the nurse’s checks logged beside them. It sits beside Form CR-1 (the crisis plan), Form TB-1 (the definitions), Form DD-1 (the counts) and Form MS-1 (medication side effects).
